info.title: SpatialUnderstanding Open API
info.description:
Public **Spatial Understanding** APIs: submit a point-cloud file to create an async task, then query task details and lists.

**Recommended flow**: upload a `.ply` via the Asset APIs to get a file URL → `POST /global/spatial-understanding/v1/tasks` to create a task → poll **Get spatial understanding task details** with the returned `taskId` until success, failure, or timeout.

**Path prefix** (relative to the gateway root): `/global/spatial-understanding/v1`.

**Input**: `inputFileUrl` accepts only an indoor `.ply` URL from Asset upload; optional `transformationMatrix` (4×4; translation in the 4th column). Coordinate system: meters, right-handed, Z-up (ScanNet). Credits are deducted when the create request is accepted.

**Async tasks**: create returns `taskId` only. When the task later succeeds, details include `result.resultSslUrl` — a UTF-8 text file (DSL) containing Wall / Door / Window / Bbox; download and parse it yourself.

**Time & paging**: `createTime` / `updateTime` in details and lists are **Unix milliseconds**; lists use `pageNum` / `pageSize` (`pageNum` starts at 1; `0` is treated as the first page).

**Auth**: set `Authorization` in the request header (API key, no Bearer prefix). See the global security scheme.

**Responses**: HTTP 200 returns a business object; HTTP 4xx returns the unified error body (including the business code).

tags.name: SpatialUnderstanding
tags.description: Spatial Understanding — create async tasks from indoor point clouds (`.ply`), poll details for Wall / Door / Window / Bbox text results, or paginate your tasks.

post.description: Creates an async spatial understanding task that detects walls, doors, windows, and object 3D bboxes from an indoor point cloud. `inputFileUrl` must be a `.ply` URL from Asset upload. The point-cloud coordinate system is meters, right-handed, Z-up; if it is not aligned, pass `transformationMatrix` (translation in the 4th column). Credits are deducted on acceptance. Returns `taskId` only (same as the path parameter of **Get spatial understanding task details**). After the task succeeds, details include `result.resultSslUrl` as a DSL text file — download and parse it yourself.

requestBody.description: Create-task body. `inputFileUrl` is required and must be an indoor `.ply` URL from Asset upload. Optional `transformationMatrix` aligns the cloud to meters, right-handed, Z-up.

createWithMatrix.summary: Include a 4×4 transform (rotation and translation; translation in the 4th column)

200.description: Accepted. Returns `taskId` for polling task details.

400.description: Validation failed, invalid point-cloud URL, invalid transform matrix, or insufficient credits (`details.metaData.bizCode` is the business code)

invalidInputUrl.summary: inputFileUrl is invalid or not a .ply
invalidInputUrl.description: Business code 13001. Use a `.ply` URL returned by the Asset upload APIs.

value.message: invalid file url, please upload a .ply file via the Asset module APIs

details.message: invalid file url, please upload a .ply file via the Asset module APIs

invalidTransformationMatrix.description: Business code 13002. Must be a 4×4 array of valid numbers.

value.message: invalid transformation matrix, expect a 4x4 numeric array

details.message: invalid transformation matrix, expect a 4x4 numeric array

get.description: Get details for a task owned by the current account. `PENDING` / `RUNNING` means it is not finished — keep polling. On `SUCCEEDED`, the response includes `result.resultSslUrl` (DSL text with Wall / Door / Window / Bbox; download and parse it yourself). On `FAILED` / `TIMEOUT`, the response includes `errorCode` and `errorMessage`.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Task id (same as `taskId` in the create success response)

failed.summary: Failed, includes error code and message

404.description: Task not found, or you cannot access it

post.description: Paginate spatial understanding tasks for the current account, optionally filtered by status. `pageNum` starts at 1 (`0` and `1` both mean the first page). If `pageSize` is omitted or `0`, it defaults to 20; maximum is 100.

listTaskRequest.description: Example — page 1, 20 per page, filter RUNNING and SUCCEEDED

200.description: Paged list with `pageNum`, `pageSize`, and the current page of tasks.

inputFileUrl.description: Point-cloud URL. Only `.ply` is supported, for indoor scenes. The cloud should use a right-handed coordinate system in meters and be spatially aligned ([ScanNet Alignment](https://github.com/ScanNet/ScanNet/tree/master/Alignment)): Z up, floor parallel to the X-Y plane, and major walls preferably aligned with the X or Y axis in the horizontal plane. If the input cloud does not meet this, pass `transformationMatrix`. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then put the returned URL here. External URLs are not supported.

transformationMatrix.description:
Optional. A 4×4 homogeneous transform (4 rows × 4 columns of numbers) that maps the input cloud into the aligned coordinate system above: Z up, floor parallel to the X-Y plane, and major walls preferably aligned with the X or Y axis in the horizontal plane. Omit it if the input is already aligned. Convention: column-vector multiply `p' = T p`; translation in the 4th column of this array (do not transpose); right-handed; Z-up ([ScanNet Alignment](https://github.com/ScanNet/ScanNet/tree/master/Alignment)); units in meters.

Block form: upper-left `R` is 3×3 rotation, right `t` is translation, bottom row is `[0, 0, 0, 1]`.

```
T = [ R(3×3)  t(3×1) ]
    [ 0(1×3)  1      ]
```

Request-body indices:

```
[
  [ r00, r01, r02, tx ],
  [ r10, r11, r12, ty ],
  [ r20, r21, r22, tz ],
  [   0,   0,   0,  1 ]
]
```

CreateSpatialUnderstandingTaskRequest.description: Body for creating a spatial understanding task. Indoor point clouds; coordinate system is meters, right-handed, Z-up.

taskId.description: Task id. Pass it to `GET /global/spatial-understanding/v1/tasks/{taskId}` topoll status and results.

SpatialUnderstandingTaskAsyncOperation.description: Create acceptance result with `taskId`. Use it to poll details until the task finishes.

message.description: Developer-facing error message (English); use `localizedMessage` for user-visible localized text.
message.example: Permission denied to access this resource

ApiError.description: API error response with status, details, and optional help.

Code.description: Standard REST status code following Google API design, used as a unified error-code representation.

reason.description: Error reason identifier in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, at most 63 characters

message.description: Human-readable explanation of this error, with specific context
message.example: The requested design with ID 12345 does not exist

domain.description: Error domain, usually the service that produced the error

additionalProperties.description: Additional error metadata as key-value pairs; keys at most 64 characters, matching /[a-zA-Z0-9-_]/

metaData.description: Additional error metadata as key-value pairs; keys at most 64 characters, matching /[a-zA-Z0-9-_]/

ErrorDetails.description: Error details with reason, domain, and metadata

desc.description: Description of the linked content and how it helps
desc.example: How to resolve a permission-denied error

Help.description: Help information with a documentation link

message.description: Localized error text for end users
message.example: You do not have permission to access this resource

LocalizedMessage.description: Localized message for a specific locale

pageNum.description: Page number, starting at 1; `0` and `1` both mean the first page.

pageSize.description: Page size, maximum 100; `0` or omitted defaults to 20.

statusList.description: Filter by task status (uppercase strings); empty means no status filter.

SpatialUnderstandingTaskListQueryRequest.description: Body for listing spatial understanding tasks. `pageNum` starts at 1 (`0` and `1` both mean the first page); `pageSize` is 1–100 (omitted or `0` defaults to 20). Only tasks owned by the current account are returned.

SpatialUnderstandingTaskStatus.description: Spatial understanding task status. **In progress**: `PENDING` queued; `RUNNING` running. **Terminal**: `SUCCEEDED` succeeded; `FAILED` failed; `TIMEOUT` timed out.

taskId.description: Task id, same as the create response.

modelVersion.description: Model version actually used for this task. Not specified at create time; the server uses the current default.

errorCode.description: Failure category; returned only for `FAILED` or `TIMEOUT`. `MODEL_SUBMIT_FAILED`: submit failed; `MODEL_TASK_FAILED`: execution failed; `RESULT_TRANSFER_FAILED`: result write failed; `TIMEOUT`: timed out.

errorMessage.description: Failure details; returned only for `FAILED` or `TIMEOUT`.

SpatialUnderstandingTask.description: Spatial understanding task details. On success includes `result`; on failure or timeout includes `errorCode` and `errorMessage`.

pageNum.description: Page number used for this request (starts at 1; if the request sent `0`, `0` is echoed back).

pageSize.description: Page size used for this request.

count.description: Number of records on the current page.

result.description: Task records on the current page.

SpatialUnderstandingTaskPagedList.description: Paged spatial understanding task list, including `pageNum` / `pageSize` for this request, plus the current page and totals.

resultSslUrl.description:
URL of the spatial understanding result file. UTF-8 plain text, one entity per line. The server does not return parsed JSON — download and parse it yourself.

Coordinate system: meters, right-handed, Z-up ([ScanNet Alignment](https://github.com/ScanNet/ScanNet/tree/master/Alignment)).

Line format: `{id}={Type}(arg1,arg2,...)`. Skip unknown `Type` values; do not fail the whole file.

| Type | Line format |
| --- | --- |
| Wall | `wall_{n}=Wall(ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,height,thickness)` |
| Door | `door_{n}=Door(wall_id,position_x,position_y,position_z,width,height)` |
| Window | `window_{n}=Window(wall_id,position_x,position_y,position_z,width,height)` |
| Bbox | `bbox_{n}=Bbox(class,position_x,position_y,position_z,angle_z,scale_x,scale_y,scale_z)` |

| Type | Field | Data type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wall | `ax, ay, az` | number | 3D coordinates of start point A of the wall baseline on the floor. |
| Wall | `bx, by, bz` | number | 3D coordinates of end point B of the wall baseline on the floor. |
| Wall | `height` | number | Wall height. |
| Wall | `thickness` | number | Wall thickness; currently `0.0` because the detector outputs inner-room contour edges. |
| Door | `wall_id` | string | Id of the wall that owns the door, e.g. `wall_0`; must refer to a wall in this file. |
| Door | `position_x, position_y, position_z` | number | 3D coordinates of the door-opening center. |
| Door | `width` | number | Opening width along the owning wall. |
| Door | `height` | number | Vertical height of the opening. |
| Window | `wall_id` | string | Id of the wall that owns the window, e.g. `wall_4`; must refer to a wall in this file. |
| Window | `position_x, position_y, position_z` | number | 3D coordinates of the window-opening center. |
| Window | `width` | number | Opening width along the owning wall. |
| Window | `height` | number | Vertical height of the opening. |
| Bbox | `class` | string | Object class, e.g. `chair`, `sofa`, `carpet`, `coffee_table`. |
| Bbox | `position_x, position_y, position_z` | number | Center of the 3D bounding box. |
| Bbox | `angle_z` | number | Box rotation around Z, i.e. heading in the horizontal plane. |
| Bbox | `scale_x` | number | Full extent along the box local X axis (not half-size). |
| Bbox | `scale_y` | number | Full extent along the box local Y axis (not half-size). |
| Bbox | `scale_z` | number | Full extent along the box local Z axis (height). |

Parsing tips: read line by line. `class` may contain spaces (e.g. `dining chair`); do not split on the first comma. Take the last 7 numbers from the right and treat the remainder as `class`. `class` is usually unquoted. Numbers are floats.

Format sample:

```
wall_0=Wall(1.6857,-4.4625,0.0,4.6798,-4.4474,0.0,2.73,0.0)
door_0=Door(wall_0,3.1734,-4.4550,1.05,1.3852,2.1)
window_0=Window(wall_4,5.6622,-1.0338,1.65,0.6883,1.5)
bbox_0=Bbox(carpet,-3.009,4.371,-1.401,-1.5708,5.718,6.734,0.109)
```

**Common `class` values** (use the token as-is; treat unknown values as a generic object):

`curtain`, `painting`, `nightstand`, `chandelier`, `wardrobe`, `bed`, `carpet`, `sofa`, `dining chair`, `bathroom cabinet`, `television`, `toilet`, `dining table combination`, `chair`, `shower`, `plants`, `tv cabinet`, `coffee table`, `illumination`, `shoe cabinet`, `refrigerator`, `shower room`, `wall decoration`, `cupboard`, `side table`, `stool`, `wine cabinet`, `bookcase`, `combination sofa`, `air conditioner`, `washing cabinet`, `pillow`, `stove`, `dressing table`, `desk`, `cushion`, `floor-standing lamp`, `dining table`, `washing machine`, `hand sink`, `clothes rack`, `mirror`, `sideboard`, `computer`, `potted bonsai`, `range hood`, `entrance cabinet`, `gas stove`, `multifunctional combination bed`, `leisure table and chair combination`, `bar chair`, `screen`, `sink`, `bar`, `tub`, `decorative cabinet`, `wall cabinet`, `integrated stove`, `micro-wave oven`

SpatialUnderstandingTaskResult.description: Spatial understanding task output. Returned only when the task succeeds. `resultSslUrl` points to UTF-8 text (DSL) with Wall / Door / Window / Bbox; download and parse it yourself.
